content: Yama nagkamchaku najankamu
Yama nagkamchakug, Apajuík nayaimpin nugkajai najanauwai.
Nugka niimeg atsau, ayatak nayants kuna, suwe ijiamu aajakui. Nuna awanken Apajuín Wakani
buchitu au.
Nuadui Apajuí chichaak: “¡Tsaaptin weti!” tusa tamawaik, tsaaptin wajasui.
Nuna Apajuí diis “tsaaptin aku ima pegkejai”, tusa tsaaptinun suwenmayan akankauwai.
Duwi tsaaptinun adaikauwai “tsawai”, tuja suwen adaikauwai “kashi” juna takas ejeyuwai makichik tsawantan.
Nuigtu Apajuí chichaak: “Agkaju múun wajasti, nuniak yumin akanjati”, tiuwai. Tamawaik imanisag uminkauwai.
Dutika Apajuí agkajun najana, yumi nugkaya atinun tuja yakiya atinjai akankauwai.
Dutika Apajuí agkajua nuna adaikauwai “nayaim”. Juna umik kintamag tsawak jimag tsawantan ejeyuwai.
Nuna ashimak Apajuí chichaak: “Nayaimpi nugkaan yumi ayá juka makichik ijunbaunmag ijunjati, nunitai buku wantinkati”, tiuwai. Tamawaik imanisag uminkauwai.
Yumi makichik ijunbaunmak ijunjamtai buku juwakua nuna Apajuí adaikauwai “nugka”, untsu yumi piyajua nuna adaikauwai “nayants”. Nuna Apajuí shiig pegkeg diisui.
Nuna umika Apajuí chichaak: “Ashí nugkanum dekas ajak aidau, dupa nejen aidaush, nuigtush numi nejen aidaushkam tsapakti”, tiuwai. Tamawaik imanisag uminkauwai.
Nugkanmak ashí ajak aidau tsapakui, dupa nejen aidaush antsag numi nejen aidaushkam, nejenak mantamsawag ijuntsauwai. Nuna Apajuí shiig pegkeg diisui.
Juna aatus kampatum tsawanta duwi umikui.

Tuja nuigtushkam Apajuí chichaak: “Agkaju múun wigka weaja juiyash, etsantug nugkan tsaapmitkau aidau aitnume, nunú etsantak akankati tsaaptinun suwenmayan, dutikam tsawan, nantu, mijan aina nunú dekaapatain iwainau agtinun.
Nunú nayaimpin agkajujin nanamsag etsantuinak ashí nugkan tsaapmitkau agtinme”, tiuwai. Tamawaik imanisag uminkauwai.
Nuadui Apajuí dekas jimag etsantin agtinun najanauwai: Tsawai etsanjatnun ima muuntan najanak, kashi etsanjatnunak yaijan najanauwai. Nuigtushkam yaya aidaunashkam najankauwai.
Dutika Apajuí nugkan tsawai kashijai tsaapmitkatnun, etsantin aina nuna apusauwai agkaju múun wigka weaja nuwi. Nuna Apajuí shiig pegkeg diisui.
Juna taka takakua kintamag, ipak usumta juu tsawantan ejeyuwai.

Nuna ashí umiku asa, Apajuí chichaak: “Namaka batsamsatin aidaush ditashkam yujaktinme, nuniagtai nugka awanken, nayaimpin agkajuji aina juwi yujasagtin aidaushkam, chigki wegantu aidaush yujaktinme”, tiuwai. Tamawaik imanisag uminkauwai.

Nuigtushkam Apajuí najankauwai nayantsanmaya kuntin dekas múun aina nuna, nuigtushkam tikich namak yaig aidaun nagkamas ashí najankauwai. Chigki wegantu aidaunashkam imatiksag najankauwai. Nuna Apajuí shiig pegkeg diisui.
Juna najanak Apajuí pegkegnum yumigkiak: “Yujaktajum imaniakjum nayantsanum piaktajum, tuja chigki wegantu aidautigmeshkam imanisjumek yujaktajum, imaniakjum ashí nugka jamagtajum” tiuwai.
Makichik uwejan amua tsawanta duwi junak najanauwai.

Nuigtushkam Apajuí chichaak: “Nugkanmashkam yujakti kuntin maki makichik niimtin aina nunú, kuntin tagkumtai aidau, tagkumchatai aidaujai, tuja tikich kuntin japiinas yujau aidaushkam”, tiuwai. Tamawaik imanisag uminkauwai.
Apajuí juju kuntin aidaun najankauwa nunak, ashí pegkeg diisui.

Ashí juna umik chichaak: “Yamai aents iina niimejai betek najanami, nii nugkanum pujusmatai, namak nayantsanmaya aidaush, nanamtin aidaush, kuntin aidaush, kuntin japiinas yujau aina dushakam ima niinak umigtinme” tiuwai.

content.text: Apajuí aentsun najadauwa nunak niina niimejai betek, aishmagkun nuwajai najanauwai.
tuja nayantsanmaya namak aidauk ashí atum kuitamkatajum,

content: Tusa Apajuí chichaak: “Yamai atum shiig antuktajum; ashí ajak juju nugkanmaya nejen aina nunak, numi neje yujutai aina nujai, atum yuwatnun umigkajime.

Unstu, ashí kuntin nugkanum ayá nunash, chigki wegantu aidaunashkam, japiinas yujau aina nujai, ashí pujutji ajamu aina nunak, ashí dupa samekbau aina nuna dita yuwatnujin umigkajai”, tiuwai. Tamawaik imanisag uminkauwai.
Apajuí ashí nii najankamujin ijumag diis tiki pegkeg wakejumain diisui. Juna najanak ashimak juinia uwejan makichik ijuk tsawantan ejeyuwai.

footnotes.text: “Apajuín Wakani” tawa nunak “Wakani Pegkejin” taku tawai. Duwi Nuevo Testamentonmak tutupnik Wakani Pegkeji tawai. Tuja Wakani Pegkejiya duka Apajuíyai.
